diagnostics.title: An autotools build is missing its auxiliary file: config.sub
diagnostics.suggestion: The configure script needs config.sub, which autoreconf -i (or automake --add-missing) copies in from the automake package. Running autoreconf -fi before ./configure in that step fixes it.

ask_owner.title: Documented CMake build fails at pinned commit
ask_owner.body: STRhub Verified attempted to build GangSTR from source following the repository documentation at commit 6ea9b2b. The build fails in htslib because autoreconf is run without -i (config.sub missing).
